card.name: Digits inside historical year dates
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a four-digit year (like 1<<9>>30 or 18<<2>>1) in historical passages about founding, boundaries, or institutions changing.

modes.label: Year after founding or change
modes.description: Digit in a year marking when a diocese, university, or body was founded or reorganized.
modes.example: The present diocese of Aachen was founded in 1<<9>>30.

modes.label: Parenthetical boundary dates
modes.description: Digit in a year in brackets after a territorial or political change.
modes.example: Alberta and Saskatchewan are created as provinces to make a total of nine provinces in the Dominion of Canada (1<<9>>05).

card.writes: It favors words about founding, merging, and restructuring institutions, and disfavors words describing a person.
card.plain: It fires on the digits of a year in history text about when places or institutions were founded or changed.
